# Preparing the STARS dataset
```{r code1, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}

# Load necessary libaries
setwd("~/R files/Preliminary Report")
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(bootnet)

# Load STARS dataset
data <- read.csv("stars-data_182.csv", header = TRUE)

# Retain the 51 STARS items
data <- data |> 
  select(item_1:item_51)

# Create partial correlation matrix from the 51 stars items
stars_matrix <- estimateNetwork(data, default = "pcor", 
                                threshold = 'sig') 

# Extract matrix for conversion to igraph
stars_adj_mat <- abs(stars_matrix$graph)
isSymmetric(stars_adj_mat)
stars_uw <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(stars_adj_mat, mode = 'undirected', weighted = 'weight')

summary(stars_uw)
```

# Macro-level network analysis
```{r code2, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}

# Check components
stars_comp <- components(stars_uw)

# Number of components
stars_comp$no

# Number of nodes in each component
stars_comp$csize

# 1. Average degree

degree(stars_uw) |> mean() #5.019608

# 2. Average shortest-path length

mean_distance(stars_uw, directed = F, weights = NA)  #2.658039

# 3. Global clustering coefficient

transitivity(stars_uw, type = 'global') #0.2018349

# 4. Network density

edge_density(stars_uw) #0.1003922

# 5. Network diameter

diameter(stars_uw, directed = F, weights = NA) #6

# 6. Assortative mixing
# Create a vector of factor labels based on Hanna et al. (2008)

V(stars_uw)$name # checking if STARS items are ordered correctly

V(stars_uw)$factor <- NA

V(stars_uw)$factor[c(1, 4, 8, 10, 13, 15, 21, 22)] <- 
  "Test and Class Anxiety"

V(stars_uw)$factor[c(2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 14, 17, 18, 20)] <- 
  "Interpretation Anxiety"

V(stars_uw)$factor[c(3, 16, 19, 23)] <- 
  "Fear of Asking for Help"

V(stars_uw)$factor[c(24, 26, 27, 28, 29, 33, 35, 36, 37, 40, 41, 42, 45, 47, 49, 50)] <- 
  "Worth of Statistics"

V(stars_uw)$factor[c(30, 32, 43, 44, 46)] <- 
  "Fear of Statistics Teachers"

V(stars_uw)$factor[c(25, 31, 34, 38, 39, 48, 51)] <- 
  "Computational Self-Concept"

table(V(stars_uw)$factor)


assortativity_nominal(stars_uw, types = factor(V(stars_uw)$factor), directed = F)


# Community detection using Walktrap
stars_walktrap <- cluster_walktrap(stars_uw, weights = E(stars_uw)$weight)

# Number of detected communities
length(sizes(stars_walktrap)) #9 communities

# Number of items in each community
sizes(stars_walktrap)

# Modularity of the detected community structure
modularity(stars_walktrap)

# Community membership of each STARS item
stars_communities <- data.frame(
  Item = V(stars_uw)$name,
  STARS_Factor = V(stars_uw)$factor,
  Walktrap_Community = membership(stars_walktrap)
)

print(stars_communities)

table(
  STARS_Factor = V(stars_uw)$factor,
  Walktrap_Community = membership(stars_walktrap)
)


```
